name: False-green prevention rate
definition: Share of reviewed fixture or validation cases where unsupported closure/status/promotion claims are rejected before official adoption
source: capex semantic tests and invariant audit
guardrail: No pass may rely on absence of contradiction; workpage state; generated text; external status; or unresolved SourceRefs

name: Evidence-backed blocker resolution
definition: Share of CAPEX blockers that end in canonical task or approval or artifact delta or event or pointer-request evidence rather than informal status text
guardrail: Resolved blockers must retain source_refs/evidence_refs and project scope

name: Project-scope traceability coverage
definition: Share of project-bound claims and artifacts with tenant/domain/project identity preserved through reads and provenance and pointers and exports
source: project isolation tests and schema parity
guardrail: No metric credit for cross-project visibility; null project identity in project-scoped officialness; or stale projection-only authorization

name: Fixture learning questions answered
definition: Count of accepted K12/K3/blind validation questions with expected behavior and source boundary and evidence oracle recorded
guardrail: Questions must be answered with sanitized fixtures or aggregate evidence only

name: Blind-validation defect taxonomy coverage
definition: Share of blind-validation defects classified by source-boundary or closure or project-isolation or workflow-routing or pointer or operability failure mode
guardrail: Taxonomy cannot expose raw corpus details or retrofit tests to the holdout after baseline

name: Source-to-reviewed-evidence cycle
definition: Time from source occurrence registration to reviewed evidence status for scoped fixture claims
source: source occurrence and evidence review logs
guardrail: Cycle-time credit requires resolved SourceRefs, reviewed evidence status, and no raw corpus leakage

name: Blocker-to-task routing cycle
definition: Time from surfaced blocker to canonical task/approval/flag/artifact-delta/event/pointer-request creation
guardrail: Routing speed is ignored when actor authority, source binding, stale-basis checks, or audit evidence are missing

name: Semantic and invariant gate health
definition: Pass/fail state and coverage of CAPEX semantic tests plus invariant hard gates
guardrail: Known gaps must remain explicit and cannot be hidden by aggregate pass counts

name: Isolation regression coverage
definition: Coverage of tenant/domain/project authorization and artifact identity and provenance and SourceRef and pointer same-project tests
guardrail: No credit for frontend-only filtering or projection-only authorization

name: Raw-corpus leak count
definition: Count of raw corpus markers or files or paths or extracted text or screenshots or sensitive identifiers found in repo artifacts or logs
guardrail: Any confirmed raw corpus leak blocks CAPEX activation claims

name: Restore and preflight evidence freshness
definition: Age and completeness of restore rehearsal and backup and release and preflight evidence required for pilot readiness
guardrail: Fresh evidence does not waive production-readiness gates or storage/capacity decisions

name: Projection and audit rebuild readiness
definition: Ability to rebuild advisory projections and invariant audit evidence from canonical state without granting stale access
source: projection parity tests and audit reports
guardrail: Rebuild readiness must preserve direct active membership; canonical artifacts; append-only events; and pointer truth
